items.quote: WooCommerce (WC) 2.6+ is fully integrated with the WordPress REST API.
items.why: Quote says WC integrates with WP REST API; no open-source or store-data claim.

items.quote: You may use HTTP Basic Auth by providing the REST API Consumer Key as the username and the REST API Consumer Secret as the password.
items.why: Quote states HTTP Basic with Consumer Key/Secret, the key auth part.

items.quote: You must use OAuth 1.0a "one-legged" authentication to ensure REST API credentials cannot be intercepted by an attacker.
items.why: Quote states OAuth 1.0a one-legged for the HTTP case, the key detail.

items.quote: WooCommerce includes two ways to authenticate with the WP REST API.
items.why: Quote only says two auth methods exist; nothing on self-serve keys or no approval.

items.quote: The current WP REST API integration version is `v3` which takes a first-order position in endpoints.
items.why: Quote confirms v3 is current; endpoint list and breadth not shown.

items.quote: The MCP implementation in WooCommerce is currently in developer preview.
items.why: Quote confirms an MCP implementation in WooCommerce, in preview; vendor-official status and URL not shown.

items.quote: Remote HTTP connections authenticate using a WordPress username and an Application Password.
items.why: Quote states remote MCP auth uses WordPress username and Application Password.
